name: Thenmala Ecotourism (Adventure Zone)
tagline: Post‑monsoon adventure and eco‑trails at Kerala’s first planned ecotourism spot
summary: Thenmala is India’s first planned ecotourism destination; its Adventure Zone offers post‑monsoon trekking, high‑rope courses, boating and nature trails ideal from October–May.
description: Thenmala is India’s first planned ecotourism project, set in the foothills of the Western Ghats and managed through the Thenmala Ecotourism programme. It mixes conservation, visitor education and organised outdoor activities, grouped into cultural, leisure and adventure zones. ([keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/adventure-tourism/nature-walks/thenmala?utm_source=openai))

The Adventure Zone delivers structured eco‑adventures — mountain biking, rock‑climbing and rappelling, river‑crossing and high‑rope courses — plus short guided trails and an elevated walkway that take visitors into moist deciduous and evergreen patches. Many activities operate with trained staff and accredited providers. ([keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/ecotourism/trekking-programs/thenmala-ecopackages/43?utm_source=openai))

Post‑monsoon (October–May) is the recommended season: trails dry enough for trekking while reservoirs and waterfalls run fuller, making boating and forest walks especially rewarding. Visitors should still expect occasional showers early in the season; book popular activities in advance during peak months. ([keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/adventure-tourism/watersports/thenmala?utm_source=openai))
highlights: High‑rope courses, zip/rope activities and Burma/suspension bridges
Guided eco‑trails and an elevated boardwalk through secondary forest
Butterfly Safari and a deer rehabilitation/children’s eco‑park
Cultural zone with an amphitheatre and musical fountain

sections.heading: Background
body: Thenmala opened as India’s first planned ecotourism destination and is developed to balance visitor access with conservation of the Shendurney Wildlife Sanctuary landscape. The project emphasises low‑impact infrastructure, interpretation and community participation. ([kollam.nic.in](https://kollam.nic.in/en/tourist-place/thenmala/?utm_source=openai))

sections.heading: What to see and do
body: Adventure Zone: book short, supervised challenge circuits — rope courses, valley crossings, flying‑fox and balancing obstacles — suited to families and small groups. Accredited providers run high‑rope and guided activity sessions. ([keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/ecotourism/trekking-programs/thenmala-ecopackages/43?utm_source=openai))

Eco‑trails & wildlife: take short guided nature walks and the elevated walkway for birding, butterfly spotting (Butterfly Safari) and learning about local flora; nearby Palaruvi Falls is a popular add‑on. Boating on the reservoir gives a peaceful forest‑lake view and is best when water levels are healthy after the monsoon. ([keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/images/eco-tourism/e-brochures/thenmala.pdf?utm_source=openai))

sections.heading: Plan your visit
body: Best time: October to May — post‑monsoon months (Oct–Nov) are particularly good for trails, cooler days and full streams, while many water activities operate through May. Confirm specific activity availability before you go and reserve slots for adventure circuits and boat rides. ([keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/adventure-tourism/nature-walks/thenmala?utm_source=openai))

Facilities & bookings: Thenmala has basic visitor amenities, an information centre and eateries in the cultural/leisure zone; the Thenmala Ecotourism Promotion Society and Kerala Tourism list accredited providers and booking guidance — always confirm timings, safety briefings and age/weight limits for aerial activities. ([thenmalaecotourism.com](https://thenmalaecotourism.com/?utm_source=openai))

latest.text: Kerala Tourism lists Thenmala activities and watersports as best between October and May — confirming post‑monsoon trails and boating are in season now (Oct–May).
Thenmala Ecotourism official site advises booking Adventure Zone entries and boat rides in advance; many activities operate via accredited local providers.

visitorInfo.bestTime: October–May (post‑monsoon October–November especially good for trails and full waterfalls)
visitorInfo.howToReach: Thenmala lies in eastern Kollam (about 66 km from Kollam city and roughly 70–72 km from Thiruvananthapuram). The nearest local rail stop is Thenmala; Kollam and Sengottai stations provide wider rail connections. Road access is via NH 744 / State Highway links. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thenmala))
etiquette: Book adventure circuits and boat rides ahead during peak season; many activities require slots with accredited providers.
Wear closed‑toe shoes and quick‑dry clothing; trails can be slippery immediately after rain.
Carry water, insect repellent and a light rain jacket — post‑monsoon weather is mostly pleasant but showers can return.
Respect wildlife rules: do not feed animals or stray from marked trails; avoid single‑person hikes inside sanctuary areas.
